scope: Each phase is differenced within one process before any median. Complete product self CPU through cleanup is the absolute fresh-process utime+stime total (10 ms resolution), including loader/test-harness/import startup before the first lifecycle sample; child/provider CPU is excluded. Post-cleanup evidence serialization/output is excluded from those counters but included in controller/product-exit wall. Product-startup-to-ready includes pre-provider fixture setup, not just loader time. Provider startup/control and teardown wall remain explicit. DB/WAL/SHM footprints are logical and allocated file sizes, not device writes. Other/total preserve the native driver listing: Rust recursively lists files, whereas Pi lists direct root entries (including its workspace directory); those other/total scopes are not equivalent engine comparisons; separate Source-temp sampled footprints are diagnostic profiles. RSS/PSS are observed samples, not peaks. No unrelated medians are subtracted.
